Upstream's +143-line change at d23c822 was 3-way merged with no conflicts and all 11 pairs pass; the file is otherwise verbatim.

.github/scripts/ui-tests/tests/.reason: DECLINED, not drifted: the kit-helper migration (upstream 8c1a398 batch C/S2) is an OPEN OWNER DECISION, recorded in CLAUDE.md -> 'the kit's helpers moved into tests/lib/'. Upstream moved ~1,400 lines of helpers out of templates/ui-tests/tests/app.spec.js into tests/lib/{auth,fixtures}.js and made the spec import them. This project's app.spec.js is 4,983 lines -- the stamp-era kit plus S5-S30, 26 project scenarios, 124 test instances -- so taking it means deleting the inline copies and adding the import block TOGETHER (imports without the deletions declare each helper twice: a SyntaxError that fails every scenario). It is also not mechanical: upstream's lib/auth.js hardcodes AUTH_CREDENTIAL = process.env.TEST_AUTH_CREDENTIAL || null, where this project appends || readCredentialFromClaude() (a recorded divergence, kept so local runs work without the secret), and AUTH_CREDENTIAL is consumed INSIDE that module by detectAndAuth/gotoAndAuth/gateShipsCredential, so an importer cannot override it. The three options are (A) take the lib verbatim and lose the local credential fallback, (B) take it and edit that one line, making a vendored lib CUSTOM from the day it lands, (C) defer. C is what stands. WHAT DEFERRING COSTS, stated rather than hidden: upstream's awaitAuthReady resolves on requestfinished where this project's resolves on response, so an app whose session payload STREAMS is marked ready before the gate can render (Codex, #438). TEST_AUTH_READY_REQUEST is unset here, so nothing is broken today -- it is a trap armed for whoever sets it. REVISIT TRIGGER: the owner rules on A/B/C, or TEST_AUTH_READY_REQUEST is set as a repository variable (which arms the awaitAuthReady defect), whichever comes first. Re-recorded 2026-10-25 at d23c822. tests/lib/fit.js IS taken, verbatim, because it has no imports and so does not pull the migration in; the record covers the rest of the directory (app.spec.js and the absent lib/auth.js, lib/fixtures.js).
